gnosh ssh

  Run ssh, and put what is copied on the far side onto this computer's
  clipboard. Everything after ssh goes to ssh as it is, flags included.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh ssh [ssh arguments]

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
